text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Arisa and {0} are on their way to collect
honey produced by a bee-type monster as per a request they received.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アリサと{0}は依頼を受けて、
魔物蜂の蜂蜜を採取しに向かっていた。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: *sigh*
text_block_list.orig_text: ……はぁ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not too sure myself, to be honest.
I'm just feeling kinda down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
どうしたんだろう？
私にも分かんないけど、
……モヤモヤして。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the concern.
I dunno what's up with me either, to be honest.
My chest just feels really... tight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
ありがとう。
なんか……
胸が少し痛いんだ。
なんでだろう……？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
The person who gave us this request
was super pretty, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのね。
今回の依頼をくれた人って、
すっごくきれいな人だったでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
And you got along with her well, too.
I think that's when it started.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その人とあなたが、
仲良さそうに話してるの見てたら……
なんか、
胸が痛くなったの。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It's still going, too.
I've never felt like this before,
so I'm genuinely at a loss.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まだ痛いんだ。
どうしてだろう。
こんなの、
初めてだから……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, sorry!
I should be focusing on our request first and foremost.
Can't let myself get distracted!
choice_data_list: Let's get it over with nice and quick.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ごめんねっ！
今は魔物蜂をやっつけるのが先だよね！
集中しないと……！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'm fine!
I, uh, think.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　大丈夫！
……だと、
思う。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
It'll be a cinch with my archery!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　任せて！
私の弓なら大丈夫！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
She said it was spotted around here, right?
Now we just need to find it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いるって聞いたのって、
この辺りだよね……
どこだろう……？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRRAAAAGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Looks like it found us!
But that makes things easier!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁっ！
　出た！
よぉっし……！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Urgh!
It's not letting me get a proper aim on it!
Now what...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ！
中々
狙いが
定まらない……！
どうしたら……！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Eeek?!
I-it got inside my clothes!
G-get outta there, you little...! That tickles!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……きゃあっ！？
ふ、
服の中に！？
は、ははは、
入らないで！
　くすぐったいよ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くぅんっ！？
どうしよぉ！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna grab it?!
N-no, don't you dare!
K-keep your hands out of my clothes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とる、って……
だ、
駄目だよ！
　ふ、
服の中は触ったら駄目っ！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on! It's obviously not in your—
Wh-whoa! Quit that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっちじゃないよ！？
　こっちこっち！
う、
うひゃあ！？
　そこは駄目ぇ！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
*huff, huff* Phew...
Finally got it out.
That sure wasn't fu—
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はぁ、
はぁ……
どうにか追い出せたけど……
どうすれば……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...?!
O-oh no... It stung me on the arm!
What should I do...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！？
や、
やだ……
どうしよう……！
腕、
刺されて……！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: U-urgh... My vision's going... all spinny...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ……
だめ……
視界が、
回って……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
Is this... a dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……これは、
なに？
夢かな……？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
U-umm!
Sorry to ask for another favor when you've already helped me
out a ton, but would you mind showing me the way to Landosol?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あのっ！
助けてもらったのに、
またお願いしちゃってごめんなさい！
私を
ランドソルまで連れて行ってくれませんかっ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I [i]have[/i] to get there, no matter what.
So please! Help me out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
どうしてもランドソルに行かなきゃいけないんですっ。
だから、
だからお願いしますっ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Truth is, I've never been that fond of them, myself.
So... Thanks! I'll take you up on that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えへへ。
実は、
私も堅苦しいの苦手なんです。
だから……
えっと……
うん！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
We've basically just met, but let's get along!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん！
じゃなくて……{0}くん！
これからよろしくねっ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Thanks again, {0}. Earning money was
one of the last things on my mind when I came to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えへへ。
本当にありがとね。
私、
お金のことなんかすっかり忘れちゃってて……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I really owe you one!
Helps that I enjoy being active,
plus this is a handy way to search for Losaria!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたにお仕事教えてもらってよかった！
体を動かすの楽しいし、
こうしてればロザリアが見つかるかもしれないし！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Woo!
I'm feeling extra good today thanks to you!
Let's get the rest of these deliveries wrapped up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし！
{0}くんのおかげで、
元気でちゃった！
残りも頑張ろうっと！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you.
I never would have found the courage
if I didn't know you were watching.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんのおかげだよ。
{0}くんが見ててくれたから……
だから、
勇気を出せたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I've forgotten most of it at this point,
but I think the two of us
were at the same school in it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼんやりとしか覚えてないけど……
{0}くんと一緒に学校にいた……
そんな気がする。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Weird how a dream can feel so fun.
Hopefully I'll have another one like it again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふっ、
夢は夢だけど、
楽しかったな。
またあんな夢、
見れたらいいな。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, {0}.
Teaching you helped me remember something important.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、ありがとう。
{0}くんに教えてるうちに……
私、
思い出したんだ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I never realized until now,
but {0} really is all that's been on my mind
ever since I came to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私。
ランドソルに来てからずっと、
{0}くんのことばっかり……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
How come, though?
There has to be [i]something[/i] about him...
Is it because he reminds me of Losaria? No, that can't be it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんでだろう。
どうして、{0}くんは、こんなに……
ロザリアに似てるから？
　ううん、
でも……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Where... Where am I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……
ここ、
どこ……？

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Finally awake, are we?
Don't worry. You're in a proper hospital.
Doctor! She's come to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
起きた？
　ここはランドソルの病院よ。
先生、
患者さんが目を覚ましましたよー！

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a relief.
Take some time to rest and you'll be back in top condition in no time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかい。
そりゃあ良かった。
あとは安静にしておけば大丈夫だからね。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Who are you...?
text_block_list.orig_text: あなたは……？

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
We're members of a medical guild.
You went through quite the ordeal, you know.
Do you remember being stung by a bee-type monster?
text_block_list.orig_text:
救急ギルドのメンバーよ。
あなた大変だったのよ。
蜂に刺されて……
覚えてない？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
A bee-type monster...?
Oh. Yeah, now I re—
text_block_list.orig_text:
……蜂。
そっか、
私……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...?!
What about {0}?!
H-he was there with me at the time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！？
{0}くんはっ！？
わ、
私と一緒にいたはずなんですけど……！

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Settle down, now.
He's sleeping over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着いて。
彼は無事よ。
部屋の隅でよく寝ているわ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
H-he's so beat-up...
What happened to him?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こんなボロボロに……
どうして……！？

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Apparently he got attacked by a monster while carrying you here.
Except he practically begged us to give you our full attention.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたをおんぶして運んできた時に、
魔物にやられたらしいわ。
自分のことはいいから、
アリサを助けてくれって必死だったのよ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.orig_text: そうなんですか……

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text: Well. Looks like Prince Charming's awake now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
{0}くん目が覚めたみたいよ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
{0}...!
Are you okay?! Does it still hurt?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ、{0}くん！
大丈夫っ、
痛くない……！？

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Have a look, {0}.
She's safe and sound.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、{0}くん！
　彼女も起きたわよ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I'm so sorry!
It's all my fault that you got hurt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんねっ、
ごめんね……！
私が
もっとしっかりしてれば……！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so sorry...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさい……
ごめんね……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it...
How come you're so kind, no matter what happens?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうして？
{0}くんは
どうしていつも、
そんなに優しいの……？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I had a dream, you know.
A dream about you.
About everything you've done for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私ね……
夢、
見たんだ。
{0}くんのこと、
考える夢……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
That kindness of yours has to be the reason.
The reason why I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんが
いつも優しいから……
私、
きっと……

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Now now, lovebirds.
Save the flirting for when you leave the hospital.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……彼女さん？
一応、
病室だから……
そういうのは後でね？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: L-lovebirds?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
かのっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Quiet down, now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
お静かに。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry about that.
But also... Thank you.
Not just for today, but for everything leading up to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うぅ、
ごめんね。
それから、
ありがとう。
今日だけじゃなくて、
ずっと……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Arisa brushed away a tear,
her cheeks as red as the sunset sky.
text_block_list.orig_text:
涙交じりに、はにかむアリサ。
その頬は、夕焼けのように赤く染まっていた……
